## Loading R Package

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse,sf,tmap,httr)
```
:::


## Importing ACRA data

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
folder_path <- "C:/govanzz/ISSS626_GEO_AUG_2025/In-class_Exercise/In-class_Ex03b/data/aspatial"
file_list <- list.files(path = folder_path,
                        pattern = "^ACRA.*\\.csv$",
                        full.names = TRUE)

acra_data <- file_list %>%
  map_dfr(read_csv)
```
:::


## Saving ACRA data

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
write_rds(acra_data, "C:/govanzz/ISSS626_GEO_AUG_2025/In-class_Exercise/In-class_Ex03b/data/rds/acra_data.rds")
```
:::


## Tidying ACRA data 

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
biz_56111 <- acra_data %>%
  select(1:24) %>%
  filter(primary_ssic_code == 56111) %>%
  rename(date = registration_incorporation_date) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date),
         YEAR = year(date),
         MONTH_NUM = month(date),
         MONTH_ABBR = month(date,
                            label = TRUE,
                            abbr = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(
    postal_code = str_pad(postal_code,
                          width = 6, side = "left", pad = "0")) %>%
  filter(YEAR==2025)
```
:::
